practice-double-v1.statement: Calculate \(\iint_D \left(\frac{1}{x^{2} + y^{2}}\right)\,dA,\quad D = \left\{(x,y) : 1 \le x^{2}+y^{2} \le e^{2}\right\}\quad\text{(polar coordinates)}\).

practice-triple-v1.statement: Calculate \(\iiint_E \left(- x^{2} - y^{2}\right)\,dV,\quad E = \left\{x^{2}+y^{2} \le 1,\ 0 \le z \le 3\right\}\quad\text{(cylindrical coordinates)}\).

practice-partial-v1.statement: Calculate \(\frac{\partial}{\partial z}\left(- x y^{2} z^{3}\right)\quad(x, y, z \in \mathbb{R})\).
steps: x, y\ \text{constant}:\quad \frac{\partial}{\partial z}\left(- x y^{2} z^{3}\right) = - 3 x y^{2} z^{2}

practice-partial-v1.statement: Calculate \(\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x\,\partial y}\left(3 x^{2} e^{x y}\right)\quad(x, y \in \mathbb{R})\).
steps: x\ \text{constant}:\quad \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(3 x^{2} e^{x y}\right) = 3 x^{3} e^{x y}
y\ \text{constant}:\quad \frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(3 x^{3} e^{x y}\right) = 3 x^{2} \left(x y + 3\right) e^{x y}
\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial y\,\partial x} = 3 x^{2} \left(x y + 3\right) e^{x y}

practice-partial-v1.statement: Calculate \(f = z \left(x + y\right),\quad x = r \cos{\left(\theta \right)},\ y = r \sin{\left(\theta \right)}:\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial \theta}\ \text{in}\ r, \theta, z\quad(r > 0,\ \theta, z \in \mathbb{R})\).
steps: x = r \cos{\left(\theta \right)},\quad y = r \sin{\left(\theta \right)},\quad z = z

\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = z,\ \frac{\partial x}{\partial \theta} = - r \sin{\left(\theta \right)};\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = z,\ \frac{\partial y}{\partial \theta} = r \cos{\left(\theta \right)};\quad \frac{\partial f}{\partial z} = x + y,\ \frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta} = 0

\frac{\partial f}{\partial \theta} = \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\frac{\partial x}{\partial \theta} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial \theta} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial \theta} = - r z \sin{\left(\theta \right)} + r z \cos{\left(\theta \right)}

algebra-remainder-v1.statement: Find the remainder when \(P(x)=3 x^{2} - 5 x - 5\) is divided by \(x - 2\).
Find the remainder when \(P(x)=3 x^{2} - 4 x - 3\) is divided by \(x\).
Find the remainder when \(P(x)=4 x^{2} + 2 x - 5\) is divided by \(x - 2\).

algebra-polynomial-quotient-v1.statement: Find the quotient when \(3 x^{2} - 5 x - 5\) is divided by \(x - 2\).
Find the quotient when \(3 x^{2} - 4 x - 3\) is divided by \(x\).
Find the quotient when \(4 x^{2} + 2 x - 5\) is divided by \(x - 2\).

algebra-quadratic-remainder-v1.statement: Find the remainder when \(x^{3}\) is divided by \((x)(x - 2)\).
Find the remainder when \(x^{4}\) is divided by \((x)(x + 2)\).
Find the remainder when \(x^{3}\) is divided by \((x + 2)(x)\).

algebra-determinant-scaling-v1.statement: Use the properties of determinants to find the value: \(A\in\mathbb{R}^{4\times 4},\ \det A=-2,\quad \det(-2(A^{T})^{2})=?\).
Use the properties of determinants to find the value: \(A\in\mathbb{R}^{7\times 7},\ \det A=1,\quad \det(-3(A^{T})^{3})=?\).
Use the properties of determinants to find the value: \(A\in\mathbb{R}^{6\times 6},\ \det A=-1,\quad \det(-3A^{3})=?\).

algebra-determinant-rows-v1.statement: Use the properties of determinants to find the second determinant: \(\det\begin{pmatrix}a&b&c\\d&e&f\\g&h&i\end{pmatrix}=8,\quad \det\begin{pmatrix}- 3 d&- 3 e&- 3 f\\3 a + 3 d&3 b + 3 e&3 c + 3 f\\- g&- h&- i\end{pmatrix}=?\).
steps: \det\begin{pmatrix}- 3 d&- 3 e&- 3 f\\3 a + 3 d&3 b + 3 e&3 c + 3 f\\- g&- h&- i\end{pmatrix}=\det\begin{pmatrix}- 3 d&- 3 e&- 3 f\\3 a&3 b&3 c\\- g&- h&- i\end{pmatrix}

algebra-determinant-rows-v1.statement: Use the properties of determinants to find the second determinant: \(\det\begin{pmatrix}a&b&c\\d&e&f\\g&h&i\end{pmatrix}=-2,\quad \det\begin{pmatrix}- 3 d - 3 g&- 3 e - 3 h&- 3 f - 3 i\\3 g&3 h&3 i\\- 2 a&- 2 b&- 2 c\end{pmatrix}=?\).
steps: \det\begin{pmatrix}- 3 d - 3 g&- 3 e - 3 h&- 3 f - 3 i\\3 g&3 h&3 i\\- 2 a&- 2 b&- 2 c\end{pmatrix}=\det\begin{pmatrix}- 3 d&- 3 e&- 3 f\\3 g&3 h&3 i\\- 2 a&- 2 b&- 2 c\end{pmatrix}

algebra-determinant-rows-v1.statement: Use the properties of determinants to find the second determinant: \(\det\begin{pmatrix}a&b&c\\d&e&f\\g&h&i\end{pmatrix}=3,\quad \det\begin{pmatrix}2 a + g&2 b + h&2 c + i\\- 3 d&- 3 e&- 3 f\\4 a&4 b&4 c\end{pmatrix}=?\).
steps: \det\begin{pmatrix}2 a + g&2 b + h&2 c + i\\- 3 d&- 3 e&- 3 f\\4 a&4 b&4 c\end{pmatrix}=\det\begin{pmatrix}g&h&i\\- 3 d&- 3 e&- 3 f\\4 a&4 b&4 c\end{pmatrix}

algebra-singular-parameter-v1.statement: Find the value of p for which the matrix is not invertible: \(\begin{pmatrix}1&4&3\\-4&p&3\\3&-1&-3\end{pmatrix}\).
Find the value of p for which the matrix is not invertible: \(\begin{pmatrix}1&p&-2\\2&0&-3\\-2&1&-4\end{pmatrix}\).
Find the value of p for which the matrix is not invertible: \(\begin{pmatrix}-3&3&p\\-3&-3&1\\2&4&-2\end{pmatrix}\).

algebra-inverse-2x2-v1.statement: Find the entry in the second row and first column of the inverse matrix: \(A=\begin{pmatrix}2&-1\\0&-1\end{pmatrix},\quad A^{-1}=?\).
Find the entry in the second row and second column of the inverse matrix: \(A=\begin{pmatrix}2&-2\\2&-4\end{pmatrix},\quad A^{-1}=?\).
Find the entry in the first row and second column of the inverse matrix: \(A=\begin{pmatrix}1&-1\\1&-2\end{pmatrix},\quad A^{-1}=?\).

algebra-inverse-3x3-v1.statement: Find the entry in the second row and third column of the inverse matrix: \(A=\begin{pmatrix}-2&-1&0\\2&-1&2\\4&6&-3\end{pmatrix},\quad A^{-1}=?\).
Find the entry in the first row and first column of the inverse matrix: \(A=\begin{pmatrix}-4&5&0\\2&-2&1\\-4&5&-1\end{pmatrix},\quad A^{-1}=?\).
Find the entry in the third row and second column of the inverse matrix: \(A=\begin{pmatrix}1&-1&2\\-2&1&-5\\0&0&1\end{pmatrix},\quad A^{-1}=?\).

algebra-matrix-equation-v1.statement: Find the entry in the first row and second column of the unknown matrix X: \(X\begin{pmatrix}-2&-1\\0&-2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}4&2\\-4&-8\end{pmatrix}\).
Find the entry in the first row and second column of the unknown matrix X: \(X\begin{pmatrix}2&-2\\2&-1\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}6&-3\\-2&-1\end{pmatrix}\).
Find the entry in the first row and first column of the unknown matrix X: \(X\begin{pmatrix}1&-3\\1&-2\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}1&-4\\2&-4\end{pmatrix}\).

algebra-cramer-2x2-v1.statement: Use Cramer's rule to find y in the system: \(\begin{cases}-2x-y=11\\-2y=6\end{cases}\).
Use Cramer's rule to find x in the system: \(\begin{cases}2x-2y=4\\2x-y=4\end{cases}\).
Use Cramer's rule to find y in the system: \(\begin{cases}x-3y=6\\x-2y=4\end{cases}\).

algebra-cramer-3x3-v1.statement: Use Cramer's rule to find x in the system: \(\begin{cases}-2x-y=5\\2x-y+2z=-11\\4x+6y-3z=0\end{cases}\).
Use Cramer's rule to find z in the system: \(\begin{cases}-4x+5y=-4\\2x-2y+z=3\\-4x+5y-z=-7\end{cases}\).
Use Cramer's rule to find y in the system: \(\begin{cases}x-y+2z=7\\-2x+y-5z=-14\\z=3\end{cases}\).

algebra-gauss-3x3-v1.statement: Use Gaussian elimination to find x in the system: \(\begin{cases}-2x-y=5\\2x-y+2z=-11\\4x+6y-3z=0\end{cases}\).
Use Gaussian elimination to find z in the system: \(\begin{cases}-4x+5y=-4\\2x-2y+z=3\\-4x+5y-z=-7\end{cases}\).
Use Gaussian elimination to find y in the system: \(\begin{cases}x-y+2z=7\\-2x+y-5z=-14\\z=3\end{cases}\).

algebra-gauss-4x4-v1.statement: Use Gaussian elimination to find x3 in the system: \(\begin{cases}-2x_2+2x_3+x_4=-5\\2x_1-3x_2+5x_3-2x_4=1\\-x_1+2x_2-2x_3+x_4=-2\\2x_1-5x_2+4x_3-2x_4=5\end{cases}\).
Use Gaussian elimination to find x2 in the system: \(\begin{cases}-2x_1+x_2+2x_3+5x_4=13\\x_1+2x_2+6x_3+x_4=11\\x_1-2x_4=-4\\x_1-2x_2-5x_3-5x_4=-17\end{cases}\).
Use Gaussian elimination to find x2 in the system: \(\begin{cases}-x_2=-1\\2x_1-x_2+x_4=-3\\x_2+x_3-x_4=-2\\x_1-x_2-x_3+2x_4=2\end{cases}\).

algebra-rank-v1.statement: Find the rank of the matrix: \(\begin{pmatrix}1&-2&-2&-1\\-2&5&4&4\\1&-3&-2&-3\end{pmatrix}\).
Find the rank of the matrix: \(\begin{pmatrix}1&-2&-2&1\\-1&2&2&-1\\1&-2&-2&1\end{pmatrix}\).
Find the rank of the matrix: \(\begin{pmatrix}1&-1&2&0\\-1&2&-2&-1\\2&-3&5&-1\end{pmatrix}\).

algebra-free-parameters-v1.statement: Without solving, find the number of free parameters in the general solution for the unknowns x1, x2, x3, x4: \(\begin{cases}x_1-2x_2-2x_3-x_4=4\\-2x_1+5x_2+4x_3+4x_4=-10\\x_1-3x_2-2x_3-3x_4=6\end{cases}\).

Without solving, find the number of free parameters in the general solution for the unknowns x1, x2, x3, x4: \(\begin{cases}x_1-2x_2-2x_3+x_4=1\\-x_1+2x_2+2x_3-x_4=-1\\x_1-2x_2-2x_3+x_4=1\end{cases}\).

algebra-nontrivial-parameter-v1.statement: Find the largest value of the parameter for which the system has a solution other than x = y = 0: \(\begin{cases}- 4 x + 5 y=\lambda x\\y=\lambda y\end{cases}\).

complex-root-v1.statement: Find the solution with the smallest nonnegative argument: \(z^{6}=-1\).
